title: snapshot.snapshot_internal payload
description: M4 § M9 firehose surface (deep damage). Placeholder payload at M4 (placeholder=true); M9 fills actors_with_internal with organs (humans/androids) or circuits (robots). Fires at scenario start and on every objective transition.

placeholder.description: True when emitted by M4 with a stub payload; M9 producer fills real data and clears this flag.

actors_with_internal.description: Per-actor internal state: { actor_id, origin_id (discriminator), organs: [{ organ_id, organ_kind, hp, max_hp, located_in_zone, condition, applied_afflictions }] (humans/androids only), circuits: [{ circuit_id, circuit_kind, hp, max_hp, located_in_zone, condition, applied_afflictions }] (robots only) }.
